invariants: No optimization without a stable baseline.

Negative results and failed candidates are retained.
outputs: promotion, defer, reject, or rollback decision
procedure: Freeze baseline, data, environment, objective hierarchy, and falsifier.
Run repeated controlled trials with full evidence.
Compare target metrics, guardrails, cost, and regression surface.
Promote only with reproducible evidence and tested rollback.

confidence: may adjust only through declared evidence and method
knowledge: may add or revise typed records only with provenance
memory: no persistent memory write unless explicitly contracted and scope-bound
registry: may propose changes; canonical mutation requires admission and evidence
runtime: bounded by target orchestration, permissions, containment, and rollback

summary: Run observe, benchmark, propose, test, compare, promote-or-rollback cycles across workflows, prompts, routing, retrieval, tools, and runtime settings.
title: Closed-Loop System Optimizer
when_to_use: Use only after a stable baseline and measurable objectives exist.
